questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests the ability to coordinate TLS edge routing with tenant-aware canary rollouts across two data centers using Docker DCA, Traefik rules, and Docker Configs. Encourages practical wiring, config rotation, and simple rollback semantics.

## Key Concepts
- Docker DCA multi-datacenter deployment
- Traefik Host-based routing and canary patterns
- Docker Config for per-tenant flag storage
- Canary rollout semantics and hot-reload

## Bootstrap Commands
```bash
# Create the tenant-canary Docker Config
echo 'tenant1,tenant2,tenant3' | docker config create tenant-canary -

# Deploy api-v1 (default backend)
docker stack deploy -c docker-compose.yml myapp
```

## Minimal docker-compose.yml
```yaml
services:
  traefik:
    image: traefik:v3.0
    command:
      - --providers.docker
      - --providers.docker.exposedbydefault=false
      - --entrypoints.websecure.address=:443
    ports:
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock

  api-v1:
    image: api:v1
    deploy:
      replicas: 2
    labels:
      - "traefik.http.routers.api-v1.rule=Host(`example.com`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.api-v1.entrypoints=websecure"
      - "traefik.http.routers.api-v1.tls=true"
      - "traefik.http.services.api-v1.loadbalancer.server.port=8080"

  api-v2:
    image: api:v2
    deploy:
      replicas: 2
    labels:
      - "traefik.http.routers.api-v2.rule=Host(`tenant1.example.com`,`tenant2.example.com`,`tenant3.example.com`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.api-v2.entrypoints=websecure"
      - "traefik.http.routers.api-v2.tls=true"
      - "traefik.http.services.api-v2.loadbalancer.server.port=8080"

configs:
  tenant-canary:
    external: true
```

## How It Works
- Traefik automatically discovers services via Docker labels
- Default traffic flows to api-v1 via the catch-all Host rule
- Tenant subdomains are explicitly routed to api-v2
- Adding tenants to the Docker Config and updating labels enables canary routing
- Rollback involves reverting labels or updating the subdomain list

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

This question tests the ability to design end-to-end observability in a multi-DC, TLS-protected microservice environment. It validates understanding of cross-DC trace propagation, per-tenant context isolation, centralized collection, and sampling strategies.

## Key Concepts

- OpenTelemetry instrumentation (automatic and manual)
- OTLP exporter and collector configuration
- Trace context propagation across proxies (W3C traceparent, X-Tenant)
- Tenant-scoped sampling and data governance
- Multi-DC failover and consistent trace routing
- TLS termination at Traefik edge proxy

## Bootstrap Commands

```bash
# Generate TLS certificates
openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 \\
  -keyout traefik/tls.key -out traefik/tls.crt \\
  -subj "/CN=api.example.com"

# Start the stack
docker-compose up -d
```

## Minimal docker-compose.yml Skeleton

```yaml
version: '3.8'
services:
  traefik:
    image: traefik:v3.0
    command:
      - --api.insecure=true
      - --providers.docker
      - --entrypoints.web.address=":443"
      - --entrypoints.web.tls
    ports:
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - ./traefik/tls.crt:/tls.crt
      - ./traefik/tls.key:/tls.key
    labels:
      - traefik.tls.creds=true

  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.110.0
    command: ["--config=/etc/otel-collector-config.yaml"]
    volumes:
      - ./otel-collector-config.yaml:/etc/otel-collector-config.yaml:ro
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP
      - "16686:16686" # Jaeger UI

  api-service:
    build: ./api
    environment:
      - OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://otel-collector:4317
      - OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=api-service
      - OTEL_PROPAGATORS=tracecontext,b3
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.routers.api.tls=creds
      - traefik.http.routers.api.rule=Host(`api.example.com`)

networks:
  default:
    name: dca-network
```

## OTLP Collector Config (tenant-scoped sampling)

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318

processors:
  batch:
    timeout: 10s

  probabilistic:
    sampling_percentage: 10

  filter:
    spans:
      exclude:
        match_type: strict
        attributes:
          - key: tenant.id
            value: "low-priority"

exporters:
  otlp/tempo:
    endpoint: tempo:4317
    tls:
      insecure: false

  jaeger:
    endpoint: jaeger:14250
    tls:
      insecure: false

service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      - receivers: [otlp]
      - processors: [batch, probabilistic, filter]
      - exporters: [otlp/tempo, jaeger]
```
